mapper.select: SELECT rule_id, scope, target_id, rate, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM commission_rule ORDER BY rule_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO commission_rule (rule_id, scope, target_id, rate, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{ruleId}, #{scope}, #{targetId}, #{rate}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rate = #{rate}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
